Keys: ⌘K or / palette · ⌘1–⌘6 screens (in a browser tab ⌘ switches tabs first; use ⌃1–⌃6 and ⌃K) · Tab reaches Reply, Summarize & start fresh, its ⓘ and Copy reference on each thread · Esc closes the summary preview or the ⓘ panel, else cancels the Reply strip · ⌘V in the composer pastes a copied reference · ⏎ sends.
